contests.title: Churdan — Measure IM: Local sales and services tax

provenance.sourceOrg: Greene County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the following Public Measure be adopted?

A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Churdan at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset.

Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 25% for property tax relief and 75% for any lawful corporate purpose of the city as determined by the City Council.

contests.title: Scranton — Measure GY: Local sales and services tax

provenance.sourceOrg: Greene County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the following Public Measure be adopted?

A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Scranton at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset.

Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 20% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with operating expenses of the Scranton Public Library. 30% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the general expenses of the City of Scranton. 30% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the public works department of the City of Scranton. 20% said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the water and sewer expenses of the City of Scranton.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 1% local sales and services tax starting July 1, 2027, with no scheduled end date. 25% of the revenue goes to property tax relief and 75% to any lawful city purpose chosen by the city council.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the 1% tax starting July 1, 2027, with the stated revenue uses.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this 1% tax starting July 1, 2027.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Official November 3, 2026 election page links the statewide federal and state candidate inventory, enumerates every office and district range, and states that candidates are added only after Elections Division review and acceptance.

Converted the complete official reviewed and accepted candidate inventory for all 137 federal and state office sections and all 245 printed individual names, covering the whole territory of every listed contest; paired governor and lieutenant governor into the two official ballot teams. Party-only placeholder rows are not candidates. No incumbent or website fields are printed.
